meta.scope: Syria Batch 3 — Reconstruction costs, wheat/agriculture recovery, and sanctions/external isolation densification under extremely constrained conditions.

candidates.title: Reconstruction cost and physical damage framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from World Bank and assessment sources
candidates.description: Framing of post-conflict reconstruction needs. Physical damage is estimated in the order of USD 100+ billion; total reconstruction costs are estimated near USD 216 billion — roughly an order of magnitude larger than recent GDP. Continuously cited in every recovery and external-support discussion.

candidates.title: Wheat production and food-security statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from national and monitoring sources
candidates.description: Statistics on wheat production. Output collapsed during conflict and drought years; recent seasons show recovery toward multi-million-ton levels in favourable rainfall years. Eastern governorates remain the main production base. Food security remains fragile.
candidates.notes: Core food-security crop densification under recovery conditions.

candidates.title: Sanctions and external isolation framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from policy and monitoring sources
candidates.description: Framing of the sanctions regime and gradual easing. Western sanctions have constrained banking access, trade and investment; recent political transition has opened pathways to partial relief and re-engagement, but residual isolation remains material.

candidates.title: Syria reconstruction–agriculture–sanctions densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from reconstruction, agricultural and policy sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding reconstruction cost/damage framing, wheat production statistics, and sanctions/external isolation framing into a coherent recovery–food–external layer under extremely constrained conditions.
